shared_facts.value: The artifact types supported for generation and distribution include reports, data tables, and mind maps [1].

Export destinations are strictly limited to Google Docs or Google Sheets, exposed as `notebooklm artifact export <artifact_id> --title <title> --type docs|sheets>` with no folder-id or naming-template flags in the current CLI [2].
shared_facts.note: Repo-backed clarification from src/notebooklm/cli/artifact.py: artifact export varies by --title and --type only.

shared_facts.value: The canonical reusable async control path for artifact tracking is through the poll and wait operations [2, 3].
While mind maps utilize note-backed internal storage, this implementation detail must be hidden from the user-facing CLI contract [1, 3].

fe_facts.value: The CLI provides 'notebooklm artifact poll <task_id>' and 'notebooklm artifact wait <artifact_id>' for unified lifecycle tracking [2].
The 'wait' command supports '--timeout' and '--interval' parameters for managing async polling [2].
Local filesystem output is restricted to 'download' commands; 'export' commands are reserved for cloud-backed API destinations [2].
Type-specific 'generate --wait' options are treated as convenience helpers rather than the core interface of the artifact hub [3].

be_facts.value: The core logic is implemented in the SDK via 'src/notebooklm/_artifacts.py', exposing methods for generation, download, and export [1].
The SDK artifact wait function implements exponential backoff starting at 2.0s, capping at 10.0s, with a 300.0s default timeout [2].
CLI implementation for artifact management is housed in 'src/notebooklm/cli/generate.py', 'src/notebooklm/cli/download.py', and 'src/notebooklm/cli/artifact.py' [1].
Mind map listing relies on internal storage queries located in 'src/notebooklm/_notes.py' [1].

dependencies: CLI generate, download, and artifact modules [3, 9]

notes: The facts are clearly delineated between SDK implementation and CLI contract. Parity gaps with MCP are explicitly noted in the sources and reflected in the fact set.
The export parameter gap is resolved by the current CLI contract: `artifact export` only accepts `--title` and `--type docs|sheets`, while folder placement and naming templates remain outside scope.
